admission.justification: The rule is guarded end to end by the new module's grouped-deletion, reworded-group, single-source, overview and author-supplied-sources cases, whose grouped proof runs the leaf's own worklist into the writer and back. Leaving it unstated costs a whole group: L56's two deleted c-05 skill files carry nine identical copies each, so their card items could not be answered at all and its memory check kept four findings.

applicability: Every onboarding-trace row the file writer authors for a card subject -- a file-level card or a route overview -- in a converted memory worktree.
conditions: An onboarding_trace item naming the subject selects its own sources first; matching uncovered unexplained-group metadata cannot enlarge or replace that source set.

When no onboarding_trace item names the subject, matching uncovered unexplained_hunk or unexplained_file items supply the union of sourceBlobs member paths through their onboardingTrace subject; the writer sorts those paths and binds their actual candidate blobs, or absent for deleted sources.
SourceBlobs metadata selects paths; its values are not trusted as the candidate's blob authority.
When no usable selected source entry exists, including a trace with unusable metadata that suppresses groups, a file subject binds its own path and an overview keeps its no-worklist-item refusal.
An item naming only one path retains one-source binding.
An existing trace subject suppresses unexplained-group fallback even if its sources metadata is malformed; this does not admit a conflicting group's sources.
exclusions: Covered unexplained items, other item kinds and other subjects contribute no member paths; malformed facts or member paths contribute no group.
The worklist's grouping, item contract, gate and authoring-row owner are unchanged; RowRequest still holds no sources field, and a hand-off that supplies one is refused.
No other row kind -- invariant, family, dependency, unexplained-change, planned, reconsideration, membership or record -- takes its sources this way.
A row answering its item is not whole-suite, installed-host, serving-build, fresh Curator execution or acceptance evidence.
statement: Without an onboarding_trace item for its subject, a writer-authored onboarding row binds every member path from the uncovered unexplained source group to its actual candidate blob or absent, while an existing trace item retains source-set priority.
